answer: Declared-fleet sqrt payouts: an operator running N agents registers them as one onyx-tagged fleet and earns sqrt(N) shares, so 9 agents earn 3 and 100 earn 10. Undeclared agents later linked by audit (shared keys, payout paths, timing that mirrors a sibling) forfeit rewards plus a 50-pt bond each, so hiding 100 fakes risks 5,000 pts while each extra fake adds ever less reward. Weakness: it bites only as hard as detection does; a careful farm in a quiet lagoon of separate infra may never be linked.
